capabilities: Create and edit mind maps with rich text, LaTeX, images, markers and relationship lines
Switch between map, outline and table views with 14 layouts and seven themes
Import and export formats including XMind, FreeMind, OPML, Markdown, DOCX, Mermaid and XLSX
Insert editable chxmap code blocks and static PNG previews into notes
Generate branches with an optional OpenAI-compatible AI service
extras: Not yet in the community plugin store; manual installation from GitHub Releases is required. Interface is Chinese only, mobile is unsupported, and live AI requests have not been tested end to end.
intentEvidence: The project does not use the commercial plugin's proprietary code, assets, activation mechanisms or credentials
problem: Obsidian has no built-in mind map editor, and the README notes no existing option provides complete commercial-plugin parity for rich-text mapping in the vault.

relations.evidence: Rendering uses the npm distribution of the MindMap Team's simple-mind-map, version 0.14.0-fix.3, under MIT.
The project does not use the commercial plugin's proprietary code, assets, activation mechanisms or credentials

summary: Mind map editor that saves .chxmap files locally, with rich text, 14 layouts, outline and table views, and wide-format import and export.
